note: Bios condensed from bcos.ie/newaboutus/. Professional detail retained; personal-interest detail reduced to one line each with the client's permission to be confirmed before go-live.

people.name: Carol Dwyer
people.credential: Certified by The Chartered Governance Institute · Graduate of LSB Dublin
people.lede: Leads the team at the Dublin office. Joined Beacon in 2011 and has spent her career in company secretarial practice on both sides of the Irish Sea.
body: Carol is vastly experienced in the company secretarial arena and leads the team at head office. Before joining Beacon she spent many years in London in a range of company secretarial roles.

Since returning to Ireland in 1997 she has worked with PricewaterhouseCoopers and with Hewlett-Packard International Bank plc. She is a graduate of LSB Dublin and is certified by The Chartered Governance Institute.
people.aside: Outside work: heavily involved with St. Peter's GAA, a keen runner, and three marathons in the last five years.

people.name: Sharon Spendlove
people.lede: Over ten years in company secretarial practice, with responsibility for both international and domestic clients across all aspects of corporate compliance.
body: Sharon joined Beacon in 2015. She has worked for more than ten years in the company secretarial environment and has a broad knowledge of the compliance area, with responsibility for both international and domestic clients.
She studied law and was conferred with an LLB (Hons) from the University of Cardiff, and worked in a number of legal practices before finding company law and company management.
people.aside: Outside work: a dedicated walker, often 50km a week, and a long-standing fundraiser for humanitarian causes at home and abroad.

people.name: Johnathon Pearl
people.credential: Studying with the Corporate Governance Institute
people.lede: Joined Beacon in 2024 and is currently undertaking a course with the Corporate Governance Institute.
body: Johnathon joined the team at Beacon in 2024, confirming a long-standing interest in company secretarial law and practice. He previously studied journalism at Technological University Dublin and is currently undertaking a course with the Corporate Governance Institute.
people.aside: Outside work: Gaelic football with St. Peter's in Dunboyne, golf, and a well-documented commitment to Wolverhampton Wanderers.

people.name: Emma Dwyer
people.lede: Looks after financial administration, and makes sure the firm's work is delivered on time and on budget.
body: Emma joined Beacon in 2020 and looks after financial administration. She keeps the practice running — making sure services are delivered on time and on budget.
She studied culinary arts at Athlone IT and had a successful career as a chef before joining the firm.
people.aside: Outside work: a coach with the underage section at St. Peter's GAA, Dunboyne, and a dedicated follower of Meath hurling, football and camogie.
